businessEvents.name: ssh-data:${sessionId}
businessEvents.behavior: Per-session UTF-8 chunks; subscribe before mark_session_ready; unlisten detaches only this subscriber.

businessEvents.name: ssh-status
businessEvents.definition:
#[derive(Debug, Clone, Serialize)]
#[serde(rename_all = "camelCase")]
pub(crate) struct StatusEvent {
    pub(crate) session_id: String,
    pub(crate) status: SessionStatus,
    pub(crate) message: Option<String>,
}
businessEvents.behavior: Connecting/connected/closed states emitted by original session worker; no new ordering guarantee across sessions.

businessEvents.name: agent-runtime-session-event
businessEvents.definition:
#[derive(Debug, Clone, Deserialize, Serialize, PartialEq)]
#[serde(rename_all = "camelCase", deny_unknown_fields)]
pub(crate) struct AgentSessionEvent {
    #[serde(deserialize_with = "deserialize_event_version")]
    pub(crate) version: u8,
    pub(crate) session_id: String,
    pub(crate) seq: u64,
    pub(crate) time_unix_ms: u64,
    #[serde(default, skip_serializing_if = "Option::is_none")]
    pub(crate) turn_id: Option<String>,
    #[serde(default, skip_serializing_if = "Option::is_none")]
    pub(crate) step_id: Option<String>,
    #[serde(flatten)]
    pub(crate) payload: AgentSessionEventPayload,
}
businessEvents.behavior: Version 5; sessionId/seq/timeUnixMs and flattened tagged payload; optional IDs omitted; replay remains get_events/get_committed_events.

    pub(crate) last_error: Option<String>,
    pub(crate) error_category: Option<PortForwardErrorCategory>,
}
businessEvents.behavior: Operation/profile/config IDs and runtime status/counters; no synthetic retry.

callbacks.name: desktop-resized
callbacks.adaptation: Current UI callbacks requery isMaximized; physical size is not consumed; coalescing/real window behavior stage2.

callbacks.name: desktop-drag-drop
callbacks.adaptation: DOM clientX/Y and macOS Wry coordinates are logical pixels; drop resolves webUtils paths. Phase3 verified native right-directory and left-multiple drops; Windows remains unverified.

callbacks.name: desktop-update-progress
callbacks.adaptation: Subscribe before download; finally unsubscribe; original API exposes no cancel action. Phase2 verified Started/Finished for cached and zero-progress local downloads; real installation is a stage4 condition.

callbacks.name: desktop-exit
callbacks.adaptation: Main stops core then quits; currently ignores code (existing request_app_exit uses 0).

callbacks.name: desktop-restart
callbacks.adaptation: Main stops core then relaunches, or installs already downloaded update.

privateTransport.control: length-prefixed JSON on stdin/stdout; existing request/response/validate envelopes
privateTransport.terminal: separate private Unix socket or Windows named pipe; length-prefixed JSON event plus strictly increasing terminalSeq
privateTransport.ready: protocol 1 plus required terminalChannel:true; resolve only after terminal connection exists
privateTransport.diagnostics: stderr only; bounded nonblocking log queue with explicit omission summary
privateTransport.rendererCreditSecurity: verified current main frame; no raw IPC exported; old credit IDs ignored after trusted main-frame reload

privateRequests.result: null on valid arguments; baseline Serde error otherwise
privateRequests.purpose: Main validates dialog arguments in native without executing dialogs or business commands; not exposed in preload

dynamicId: Core creates UUID v4; whitelist preserves baseline allowed event characters rather than requiring UUID on subscription. No cross-session authorization boundary inside the single trusted renderer.
unlisten: Idempotent, removes exact callback; snapshots dispatch in subscription order; no raw Electron event object exposed.
